Electro-Voice Zx5 Series Owner's Manual, © Telex Communications, Inc. 01/2007, Part Number 38110-355 Rev E (manufacturer document; hosted copy: https://www.adorama.com/col/productManuals/EVZX560B.pdf). The series specification gives 58 Hz–18 kHz (-3 dB), 39 Hz–20 kHz (-10 dB), 98 dB axial sensitivity at 1 W/1 m, 600 W continuous / 2400 W peak rated handling, 8 Ω nominal (6.5 Ω minimum), a 15-inch DVX3150 LF driver and ND2 HF compression driver, passive/biamp-selectable operation, and 132 dB calculated maximum SPL. The response/sensitivity measurement footnote says half-space. This manual covers ZX5-60, ZX5-90 and PI variants; its response, beamwidth and directivity tables are horn-variant-specific. The generic ZX5 record does not identify a horn suffix, so no variant-specific response points or directivity payload is assigned. Neither variant is assigned; the affected fields remain UNAVAILABLE.
